basic_info.description: ** Top Floor Unit - The Best of Stern Grove Condominiums **  Experience refined living in this beautiful and spacious two-bedroom, two-bath residence, ideally situated in one of the most sought after locations within the complex. With high ceilings and an abundance of natural light throughout, an attractive and well-designed floorplan offers a versatile canvas to create your own personal style for this unit.  This exceptional condominium combines luxury, comfort, privacy, and security in a quiet, serene setting. Features include: Expansive open concept living and dining area with walk-out private deck, inviting eat-in kitchen with custom cabinetry and stainless steel appliances, grand-sized primary suite offering a spacious retreat with adjoining sitting area, and in-unit laundry. There is ample storage throughout with a large deeded storage room just steps from the unit. The complex and grounds are well maintained with 24 hour security.  Great walk-score with nearby West Portal Village shops, restaurants, and public transportation.  Don't miss this one in your search!
